auth_method.title: Choose Authentication Help
auth_method.description:
**Wizard (Recommended)**: Guided step-by-step process with clear instructions to extract credentials from your browser.

**Manual**: Condensed instructions for users already familiar with browser developer tools.

wizard_login.title: Wizard: Quick Setup
wizard_login.description:
## 🚀 Quick & Easy Credential Extraction

**Just 3 simple steps:**

### Step 1: Open Nest in Private Browser

1. Open [home.nest.com](https://home.nest.com) in a **private/incognito window**
2. **Sign in** with your Google account
3. Enable **third-party cookies** if prompted

### Step 2: Run the Helper Script

1. Press **F12** on your keyboard (or right-click → Inspect)
2. Click the **Console** tab
3. Copy and paste this one-line script:

**Copy this:**

    (async()=>{try{if(!location.hostname.includes('nest.com'))return alert('❌ Run on home.nest.com');const t=performance.getEntriesByType('resource').find(e=>e.name.includes('issueToken'));if(!t)return alert('❌ No token found. Refresh page and try again');const i=t.name,c=document.cookie;if(!i.startsWith('https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc')||!i.includes('action=issueToken'))return alert('❌ Invalid token');if(!c||c.length<100)return alert('❌ Please sign in first');await navigator.clipboard.writeText(i+'\n\n'+c);alert('✅ Copied! Paste below in Home Assistant')}catch(e){alert('❌ Error: '+e.message)}})();

4. Press **Enter** - credentials will be automatically copied!

### Step 3: Paste Below

The credentials are now in your clipboard. Just paste them in the fields below:
- First line goes in **Issue Token URL**
- Everything else goes in **Cookies**

💡 **Tip**: On mobile, use Chrome or Safari in private mode and enable Desktop Site for easier console access.

account_link.title: Connect Your Nest Account
account_link.description:
Follow these steps to get your credentials:

1. Open an **Incognito/Private** browser window
2. Enable **third-party cookies** in browser settings
3. Go to [home.nest.com](https://home.nest.com) and sign in with Google
4. Open **Developer Tools** (F12) → **Network** tab → Check **Preserve Log**
5. In the filter box, type `issueToken` and copy the full **Request URL**
6. In the filter box, type `oauth2/iframe`, click the last request, and copy the entire **Cookie** header value

⚠️ Do not log out of home.nest.com after copying credentials
